steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each course is placed by whether its records are current, overdue or missing from the matrix.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Required course with no record for a role
findings.fix: Book the course for the role

findings.title: Person in the role with no matrix entry

outcome.notChecked: The quality of the training; whether the training was applied on the job.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] course-first-aid.md:12  Required course with no record for a role.
       Fix: Book the course for the role.
[medium] course-forklift.md:19  Record past its refresh date.
       Fix: Book the refresher.
[low] course-chemical.md:26  Person in the role with no matrix entry.
       Fix: Add the matrix entry.
Not checked: The quality of the training; whether the training was applied on the job.
pros: Checks a required course with no record, a record past its refresh date, and a person in the role with no matrix entry.
cons: Not checked: The quality of the training; whether the training was applied on the job.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-training-compliance skill on the records for this review.
